name: Restructure priority selection logic
template: Rewrite a priority or case selection cone into an equivalent balanced or directly decoded selection form.

example.before: always @* if (s0) y=a; else if (s1) y=b; else y=c;
example.after: always @* casez ({s0,s1}) 2'b1?: y=a; 2'b01: y=b; default: y=c; endcase

guardrails: Preserve exact priority, default behavior, widths, and X-sensitive semantics.
Do not introduce state or change latency.
Change only the source-attributed selection cone.
